name: eleQt
tagline: A quantum-secured vote-tallying protocol using oblivious transfer and quantum key distribution.
problem: Future quantum computers could break today's election cryptography.
solution: Implements quantum oblivious transfer with an E91 key-distribution protocol for trustless tallying, with IBM quantum tools.
demo_moment: Team-described: run a tally with the protocol.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Computational Quantum Track Hack” among 223 submissions.

lessons: Pick a high-stakes use for frontier crypto.
